name: OmaCal
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Omarchy's stock clock and calendar with your calendars laid over it: HEY, Google Calendar and .ics feeds side by side, per-calendar event chips on the month grid, a day view, new events from the panel or a quick-add shortcut, reminders as notifications, the next event in the bar, and HEY time tracking.

barWidget.description: The stock date/time label and calendar popup, with your calendar in it.

schema.label: Read Google Calendar
schema.description: Reads and writes Google Calendar, signed in through gws, the Google Workspace CLI (`gws auth login -s calendar`).

schema.label: Read calendar feeds
schema.description: Reads the .ics feeds added in OmaCal's own settings, which keeps their addresses in ~/.config/omacal/feeds.json.

schema.label: Event in the bar
schema.description: "soon" shows an event's name and when, from its earliest reminder until it ends. "name" and "time" show only one of the two. "next" always shows today's next event. "off" shows only the calendar glyph.

schema.label: Show event reminders as notifications
schema.description: Uses the reminders set on each event in HEY or Google, and the alarms a feed carries.

schema.label: Suggest places
schema.description: Offers places while you type in Where?, from Google with a Google Maps API key (set in OmaCal's own settings) or else OpenStreetMap. What you type there is sent to that service.

schema.label: Quick add shortcut
schema.description: Opens the new-event card from anywhere. Leave empty to turn it off. A shortcut already in use is not taken.

schema.label: Show the calendar icon this many minutes ahead
schema.description: The icon appears this long before an event starts and stays until it ends. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Follow HEY changes live
schema.description: Keeps a `hey watch` running so edits made in HEY show up within seconds. Google and feeds are polled at the refresh interval.

schema.label: Hidden calendars
schema.description: Comma-separated calendars to leave out: keys such as hey:7, as the settings write them, or names, which hide that name on every service. Needed on hey-cli 1.3, which cannot see which calendars are switched off in HEY.
